name: Sunway Healthcare Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sunway Healthcare Holdings Berhad 完成首次公开募股并在马来西亚交易所主板上市。业务上，公司通过收购土地和物业扩大医疗中心网络，包括 Sunway Medical Centre Velocity 的 Tower A、槟城物业、Seremban 土地及柔佛依斯干达公主城四块土地，并与 Putrajaya Holdings 成立合资公司开发 Sunway Medical Centre Putrajaya。
overview_en: In 2026, Sunway Healthcare Holdings Berhad completed its initial public offering and listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia. On the business front, the company expanded its medical centre network through acquisitions of land and properties, including Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity, a Penang property, land in Seremban, and four parcels of land in Iskandar Puteri, Johor, and formed a joint venture with Putrajaya Holdings to develop Sunway Medical Centre Putrajaya.

segments.name: 医疗中心及设施
segments.note: 今年通过收购物业和土地扩大医疗中心版图，并推进 Putrajaya 医疗中心合资项目。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment expanded its medical centre footprint through property and land acquisitions and advanced the Putrajaya medical centre joint venture.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 Sunway Medical 3C4 与 Sunway Integrated Properties 签署买卖协议，收购 Sunway Medical Centre Velocity 的 Tower A 较低12层物业。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Sunway Medical 3C4 signed a sale and purchase agreement with Sunway Integrated Properties to acquire the lower 12 floors of Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sunway Healthcare Ventures 与 Tapak Senja 签署合资及股东协议，开发 Sunway Medical Centre Putrajaya。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sunway Healthcare Ventures signed a joint venture and shareholders agreement with Tapak Senja to develop Sunway Medical Centre Putrajaya.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sunway Medical Centre Penang 与 RHB Trustees 签署补充协议，以 RM60.0 million 收购 Sunway Hotel Seberang Jaya 物业。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sunway Medical Centre Penang signed a supplemental agreement with RHB Trustees to acquire the Sunway Hotel Seberang Jaya property for RM60.0 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 99.9% 子公司 Sunway Medical Centre 与 Sunway Sentral Seremban 签署买卖协议，收购 Seremban 约 2.1 英亩永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: 99.9%-owned subsidiary Sunway Medical Centre signed a sale and purchase agreement with Sunway Sentral Seremban to acquire approximately 2.1 acres of freehold land in Seremban.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 99.9% 子公司 Sunway Medical Centre 与 Sunway Marketplace、Sunway Parkview 及 Sunway Iskandar 签署买卖协议，收购柔佛依斯干达公主城四块合计约 9.918 英亩的永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: 99.9%-owned subsidiary Sunway Medical Centre signed a sale and purchase agreement with Sunway Marketplace, Sunway Parkview and Sunway Iskandar to acquire four parcels of freehold land totaling approximately 9.918 acres in Sunway City Iskandar Puteri, Johor.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 99.9% 子公司 Sunway Medical Centre 接受 Sunway Sentral Seremban 的献议书，收购 Seremban 约 2.1 英亩永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: 99.9%-owned subsidiary Sunway Medical Centre accepted a letter of offer from Sunway Sentral Seremban to acquire approximately 2.1 acres of freehold land in Seremban.
